To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
KATP channel activation in beta cells is mediated by an AK-CK interaction.

the ATP sensitivity of K+ channels in pancreatic beta cells is determined not only by the local ATP concentration in the immediate vicinity of the channels, but also by the ATP:ADP concentration ratio in the vicinity of these channels.
KATP channels are regulated by the local ATP: ADP ratio in pancreatic beta cells, which is determined by the phosphotransfer enzymes AK and CK.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the regulation of KATP channel function in the pancreatic beta cells.
the question whether and how metabolic interactions between CK and AK determine the open probability and the actual rate of KATP channel opening.
the question of how metabolic signals are converted into electrical signals and, ultimately, into hormonal signals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the AK-CK interaction is an essential part of the KATP channel signalling system.

AK1 is a key enzyme in the regulation of the ATP/ADP ratio in mouse pancreatic beta cells and that the local ATP/ADP concentration in the proximity of KATP channel is a major determinant of KATP activity and insulin release.
KATP channel opening is regulated by the balance of ATP and ADPR produced by CK and AK.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the metabolic state of the cell determines the open probability of beta cell KATPP channels and thus insulin secretion.
the KATP channel is an ATP-sensitive enzyme, but not a direct target for ATP.
the ATP/ADP ratio, and thus the KATP channel open probability, is not only determined by the metabolic status of the cells, but also by the metabolic interaction between AK and CK.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the local concentration of ATP and ADPs in beta cell KATPs are not determined by the global ATP and ADP levels in the cytosol but rather by the local metabolic activity in the vicinity of KATP channel.
the local ATP concentration is determined by a balance between the ATP-consuming KATP channels, ATP production via CK and the AK-catalysd conversion of ATP into ADP and AMP.

the metabolic state of beta cells is not determined by the bulk ATP concentration but by a complex network of metabolic interactions that determine ATP and ADP concentrations at the site of ATP-sensitive channels.
